respuesta.razonamiento: Merged the 10 visual boxes with narration references. b4 (DATA LAKE) is mapped to S3 as the narration describes raw and refined S3 buckets forming the data lake. CDC is treated as a DMS feature rather than an independent service. ERP System (ThirdParty) and Business Users (UserCompanyAnalyst) are included from narration as the source of demand files and end-user consumers respectively. The architecture captures two ingestion workflows into Redshift and the Data Lake (on-premises CDC replication and S3/event-driven file processing) as well as analytical querying.
respuesta.nombre: Hybrid Sales and Demand Data Lake Analytics Architecture

edges.respaldo: line b7->b8, 'That data is actually piped through our VPN'
line b8->b9, 'we use DMS and CDC to be able to pull that data out of our VPN'
line b9->b6, 'pull that data and then populate it into our Redshift cluster'

edges.notes: makes data available to data lake
edges.respaldo: line b6->b4, 'that then makes it available to not only our data lake'

edges.notes: ERP demand data uploaded to drop bucket
edges.respaldo: 'some of that demand from our ERP system that came into our drop bucket, our S3 drop bucket here'

edges.notes: file landing kicks off SQS message
edges.respaldo: line b0->b1, 'When those files landed, they actually kick off an SQS that handles all of our messaging services'
line b1->b2, 'SQS will launch what we call our initiator Lambda job'
line b2->b3, 'This Lambda job actually talks to DynamoDB and it pulls the metadata'
line b2->b4, 'the Lambda will... understand how to populate our data lake and push that information into the appropriate structures'

edges.notes: S3 event trigger launches next Lambda
edges.respaldo: line b4->b5, 'we have a trigger on our S3 bucket that's event driven and it will launch our next Lambda job'

edges.notes: Lambda feeds processed data into Redshift
edges.respaldo: line b5->b6, 'Once that completes, that is fed into Redshift again'
'our business users and all of our leaderships can use many different tools to be able to query and get that data out'
